decision.next_action: If this gate fails, close lightweight evening state-transition features as another ID342-aware local lane. If both Q3 and S3 pass, use Kaggle no-submit only for parity review before any artifact.

feature_contract.domain_read: Q3 is pre-sleep stress and S3 is sleep-onset-latency adherence. This gate uses pre-sleep screen/app/HR activity and settling into darkness/charging/stillness, with previous-day label-free deviations and fold-internal subject baselines.

purpose: Test whether fold-internal evening arousal/settling transitions and previous-day deviations add Q3/S3 signal beyond ID342.

research_sources.read: ETRI defines Q3 as pre-sleep stress and S3 as sleep-onset-latency guideline adherence; the baseline section reports that task-specific time-zone features beat all-feature bundles.
research_sources.title: ETRI Lifelog Dataset 2024

research_sources.read: NSF frames sleep quality around latency, awakenings, WASO, and efficiency, with adult latency screening at falling asleep within 30 minutes.
research_sources.title: National Sleep Foundation - What Is Sleep Quality?

research_sources.read: NSF's sleep-timing guidance motivates regularity and previous-day deviation features rather than only same-day absolute sensor totals.
research_sources.title: National Sleep Foundation - Consistent Sleep Schedules

research_sources.read: Pre-bed device light and alerting effects motivate screen/light/usage settling features for S3 and Q3, while keeping the gate strictly empirical.
research_sources.title: Sleep Foundation - Electronics and Sleep
